title: Homological Mirror Symmetry for Affine Log Calabi-Yau Surfaces
summary: Let $U$ be a smooth complex affine log Calabi--Yau surface, and let $\widehat{U}$ be its complete finite-type Liouville manifold, equipped with its natural grading structure. We give an algorithm that constructs a finite-type quasi-projective $\mathbb{Z}$-scheme $U^\vee$ such that \[ D^π\bigl(\mathcal{W}(\widehat{U},\Bbbk)\bigr) \cong D^b\operatorname{Coh}(U^\vee_{\Bbbk}) \] for every field $\Bbbk$.
